description: This file defines the CandidateHistoryDecorator class, which provides methods to associate and manipulate CandidateHistory entities within the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin. It includes utility functions such as setting related entities by ID and retrieving formatted action and date information.

classes.name: CandidateHistoryDecorator
classes.description: Decorator class to manage candidate history records, linking candidates, vacancies, interviews, and employees, while providing formatted output for actions and dates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a CandidateHistory entity.

methods.name: setCandidateById
methods.description: Sets the candidate associated with the history record using the candidate's ID.

methods.name: setVacancyById
methods.description: Sets the vacancy associated with the history record using the vacancy's ID.

methods.name: setInterviewByInterviewId
methods.description: Associates an interview with the candidate history by interview ID.

methods.name: setPerformedBy
methods.description: Sets the employee who performed the action by employee ID.

methods.name: getCandidateHistoryAction
methods.description: Returns a formatted string representing the action performed in the candidate history, based on predefined status maps.

methods.name: getPerformedDate
methods.description: Retrieves and formats the date when the action was performed.
